sloka: नैमिषे वसतस्तस्य सर्व एव नराधिपाः ।आनिन्युरुपहारांश्च तान्रामः प्रत्यपूजयत् ।। ७.९२.४ ॥
transliteration: naimiṣe vasatastasya sarva eva narādhipāḥ ।āninyurupahārāṁśca tānrāmaḥ pratyapūjayat ।। 7.92.4 ॥

translations.english: While Rama was residing in Naimisha, all the kings brought him gifts, and Rama, in turn, honored them.
